policy: RFC 0003 J3: every live thread of a running product belongs to a declared owner. Owners are name patterns (OS thread names with the pool index stripped, as tier0 names pool workers) with an owner and a reason. The executable's name is the main thread, once. Everything else is undeclared and only shrinks (tools/quality/thread_census.py --write after review); J3 needs undeclared empty. Driver and platform-library threads depend on the runner's GPU and devices, so a new runner may add a declared pattern with its reason.

owners.reason: the engine compute pool the root lends to job graphs (RFC 0003 capacity policy); its size is -compute_workers
the material system's queued render sequence (mat_queue_mode 2)
the save/restore pool: blocking file writes kept off the compute pool
SDL3's audio device and PipeWire threads
libusb event threads behind SDL3's HID gamepad support
